_readme: Copy this file OUTSIDE every git repo (recommended: ~/.preiss/finance/finance-snapshot.json, i.e. C:\Users\<you>\.preiss\finance\ on Windows). Fill in real numbers there. personal-os is PUBLIC on GitHub - real figures never go into it. Percent fields are percents (12.5 = 12.5 %). Amounts are monthly unless the key says otherwise.

debts.name: example credit card
debts.note: index_rate is the CPI indexation of a verdtryggt loan; 0 for a non-indexed one

notes: what changed since the last snapshot, in one line
